name: Accept or Reject Terms and Conditions
summary: Present the current Terms and Conditions as one bounded client interaction and allow the person to explicitly accept or reject them before returning control to the agent.

invocation.notes: The client resolves and displays the authoritative current Terms and Conditions through its normal backend contract. The directive does not transport Terms and Conditions content or acceptance state.

outcomes.name: Accepted
outcomes.summary: The person explicitly accepted the Terms and Conditions and the client completed the authoritative acceptance operation.

outcomes.name: Rejected
outcomes.summary: The person explicitly rejected the Terms and Conditions.

outcomes.name: Canceled
outcomes.summary: The person dismissed or abandoned the interaction without accepting or rejecting the Terms and Conditions.

outcomes.name: Failed
outcomes.summary: The client could not complete the Terms and Conditions interaction because the authoritative operation failed.

responseContract.notes: The terminal outcome fully expresses the control-flow result. No response value is returned.

angularWeb.notes: A proven Angular prototype retrieves and accepts the real Terms and Conditions through the existing continuity promotion flow. It predates this canonical Client Interaction contract and requires conformance reconciliation.

reactNative.notes: React Native implementation has not yet been reconciled against this Client Interaction contract.

sourceReferences.note: Defines the one-directive, one-card, bounded-response contract.
Documents the existing offerPromotion prototype, real Terms and Conditions retrieval and acceptance, and the agent/client security boundary.
Selected Accept or Reject Terms and Conditions as the first reference Client Interaction specimen.
